fellers.songTitle: You Can’t Get a Man with a Gun
fellers.line: The gals with umbrellas are always out with fellers
stanza: The gals with umbrellas are always out with fellers
In the rain or the blazin' sun
But a man never trifles with gals who carry rifles
Oh, you can't get a man with a gun
With a gun, with a gun
No, you can't get a man with a gun
